newsitem.title: JAPAN: Moody's says may downgrade Uniden's long-term debt.
newsitem.headline: Moody's says may downgrade Uniden's long-term debt.

text.p: Moody's Investors Service said on Monday that it had placed Uniden Corp's long-term debt under review for a possible downgrade.
Under review is Uniden's Ba3 senior unsecured long-term debt rating, Moody's said in a statement.

The review reflects Moody's increasing concern about Uniden's financial leverage based on expectations of large investments in the future and a weakening outlook for Uniden's competitive position in the global wireless communications equipment market, Moody's said. Uniden is a major supplier of radio communications equipment, primarily in the United States, Moody's said.
